items.q: What should you remember about **Buffet, not dogma**?
items.a: **Huberman uses phone/email/social; Newport minimizes** both; shared goal = protect blocks for highest-quality cognitive work.

items.q: What should you remember about **Time blocking > to-do lists**?
items.a: **Grapple with actual calendar gaps;** short gaps → admin; first 90 min → hardest deep work.

items.q: What should you remember about **Pull vs push**?
items.a: **Email is a public post to-do list; push-based** orgs drown workers; pull-based = fixed concentration budget + active-list queue (Trello cards, not meetings about inactive projects).

items.q: What should you remember about **Multiscale cascade**?
items.a: **Quarter/season objectives inform weekly plan** inform daily time blocks; free-form text weekly plan is enough.

items.q: What should you remember about **Shutdown ritual**?
items.a: **Review inbox, plan, calendar; capture** open loops; sense of tomorrow; physical phrase/gesture to end work mode.

items.q: What should you remember about **~4–4.5 h quality brain/day** (Newport)?
items.a: **Low phone/internet use compounds;** midnight-oil myth; network switching hidden tax.

items.q: What should you remember about **Task switching cost**?
items.a: **Phone excels at inducing** expensive attention-network switches; "text bankruptcy" several times daily.

items.q: What should you remember about **Solitude deprivation**?
items.a: **Cognitive solitude = absence of stimuli** from other human minds; smartphones make all-day social-processing mode possible → anxiety/exhaustion.

items.q: What should you remember about **Deliberate practice ≠ flow**?
items.a: **Pro musicians push 20% past** comfort, forget to breathe; flow loses time; growth requires discomfort (Anders Ericsson).

items.q: What should you remember about **Pseudo productivity**?
items.a: **Knowledge work measured by visible** activity because we lacked better metrics when the sector emerged mid-20th century.

items.q: What should you remember about **Hyperactive hive mind**?
items.a: **Checking email every 2 min is** like neglecting a $20M factory robot; requires org-level workflow change, not individual willpower alone.

items.q: What should you remember about **30-day digital minimalism**?
items.a: **White-knuckle abstinence fails; aggressively** pursue replacement activities (hobbies, exercise, libraries, structure).
